critical_appraisal.rule: No empirical or review source may carry a release-ready load-bearing claim until its design, outcome anchor, limitations, and independent appraisal are recorded.

domain_sources_to_add_manually: Web of Science or Scopus, if licensed

eligibility.date_policy: No lower bound for foundational writing, readability, or evaluation methods; generative-AI evidence searched through the protocol cutoff date.

exclude.reason: No AI-assisted writing, feedback, reader, or writing-evaluation construct.
Generation-only benchmark with no human-writing workflow or transferable evaluation result.
Opinion, commentary, marketing claim, or tutorial without reviewable methods; official policy and documentation excepted.
Detector-evasion or misconduct-enablement objective; detector validity studies may remain eligible for risk analysis.
Duplicate report of the same study without additional methods or results.
Insufficient bibliographic identity or inaccessible evidence for the claim proposed.
Non-English full text not assessable within the declared review resources.

include: Empirical studies with a human writer, editor, reviewer, reader, or workplace outcome relevant to Q1-Q4.
Empirical evaluations of generated writing, feedback, revision, citation reliability, or writing-quality judgments relevant to Q1-Q3.
Systematic, scoping, or mapping reviews with explicit search and selection methods relevant to Q1-Q4.
Foundational measurement studies needed to define or validate an evaluation construct.
Official reporting standards, governance policies, API documentation, and primary software documentation relevant to Q5-Q6.
eligibility.scope: Evidence about AI-assisted human writing, writing feedback or evaluation, reader response, scholarly integrity, professional writing work, and implementation components needed by humanvoice.
eligibility.screening_rule: Two reviewers independently apply the same criteria; disagreements require a recorded adjudication and excluded full texts require one exclusion code.

product_requirements.acceptance_test: A low-context reader can state the purpose, object, and requested action, the leak fixture finds no forbidden internal register, and every released file traces to a source hash and version.
product_requirements.statement: Keep the reader-facing manuscript separate from the audit and provenance record, linked by immutable document and version identifiers; internal workflow vocabulary must not leak into the manuscript.
product_requirements.title: Reader-facing separation

product_requirements.acceptance_test: Conflict fixtures resolve in the declared order and LaTeX-specific configuration disables rules that would alter protected syntax.
product_requirements.statement: Resolve conflicts in the order correctness, source fidelity, domain meaning, reader comprehension, then template regularity; store project and format overrides in configuration rather than manuscript prose.
product_requirements.title: Configurable policy precedence

product_requirements.acceptance_test: Every diagnostic fixture returns stable locations and no command mutates its input; accepted edits are remeasured and recorded separately.
product_requirements.statement: Diagnostics emit categories, source spans, measurements, context, and editorial questions; only an explicit author or editor action may change text.
product_requirements.title: Located diagnostics without automatic rewriting

product_requirements.acceptance_test: Historical replay preserves a result for every layer and prevents a later-layer score from concealing an unresolved earlier defect.
product_requirements.statement: Diagnose and repair register leakage, mechanical repetition, defensive prose, substance, and reader comprehension in that order while retaining intermediate results.
product_requirements.title: Layered diagnosis and repair

product_requirements.acceptance_test: Repair replay produces zero unexplained protected-token changes and blocks promotion on any unexplained deletion, insertion, or mutation.
product_requirements.statement: Represent equations, labels, citations, numbers, claims, code, tables, and quoted text as protected content and explain every substantive change between versions.
product_requirements.title: Protected meaning-preserving diff

product_requirements.acceptance_test: Seeded valid, nonexistent, wrong-DOI, duplicate, and title-mismatch cases are classified correctly, and every load-bearing claim has a human-verified full-text anchor.
product_requirements.statement: Resolve bibliographic identity separately from source-to-claim support, retain a sentence-level claim anchor, and block release on an unresolved load-bearing citation.
product_requirements.title: Citation identity and claim support

product_requirements.acceptance_test: A frozen human-labelled set reports agreement and order, verbosity, and family-sensitivity diagnostics before a judge result can enter analysis.
product_requirements.statement: Use model judges only for construct-specific screening after pair-order randomization, length control, cross-family checking, and calibration against recorded human labels.
product_requirements.title: Calibrated model judging

product_requirements.acceptance_test: Every promoted document records the pseudonymous reader, immutable document hash, rubric response, decision, requested changes, and elapsed time.
product_requirements.statement: A human reader, not a surface metric or model judge, is the promotion authority for a specific document version.
product_requirements.title: Named human acceptance

product_requirements.acceptance_test: Tuning and holdout hashes are frozen before execution, each package has a human-labelled scorecard, and no smoke test is reported as effectiveness.
product_requirements.statement: Evaluate diagnostic packages and the complete workflow on documents not used for rule tuning, and separate surface, process, higher-order, and acceptance outcomes.
product_requirements.title: Held-out behavioral evaluation

product_requirements.acceptance_test: The release packet contains the required provenance records while the manuscript passes the internal-register leak test and a reader can identify the argument without process context.
product_requirements.statement: Use one bounded plan and one result record per work package; do not expose audit ledgers, gate names, or orchestration state in reader-facing prose.
product_requirements.title: Minimal process surface

product_requirements.acceptance_test: An unapproved remote route is blocked, approved calls produce a complete disclosure record, and the minimum-content retention policy is enforced.
product_requirements.statement: Keep protected manuscripts local by default and record provider, model, purpose, retention policy, disclosure status, and approval for every remote call.
product_requirements.title: Privacy and disclosure

product_requirements.acceptance_test: The drift command refuses single-document analysis, suppresses small cells, and reports uncertainty and baseline sensitivity for aggregate trends.
product_requirements.statement: Monitor aggregate vocabulary and structural convergence against an appropriate pre-assistance baseline, but never classify the authorship of an individual document.
product_requirements.title: Population-level convergence without attribution

product_requirements.acceptance_test: End-to-end replay reconstructs the intervention path from hashes and event records, distinguishes edited acceptance from direct acceptance, and applies the retention class.
product_requirements.statement: Record writer intent, suggestion, acceptance, edit, rejection, and rollback events without retaining unnecessary manuscript content.
product_requirements.title: Interaction telemetry

product_requirements.acceptance_test: The preregistered analysis reports uncertainty for each prespecified stratum and applies the stop rule if expert writers or a task class are harmed.
product_requirements.statement: Report effects by baseline writer skill, document task and genre, and reader role; do not deploy from an average effect that conceals subgroup harm.
product_requirements.title: Heterogeneous outcomes

product_requirements.acceptance_test: Pandoc, pylatexenc, plasTeX, LaTeXML, and tree-sitter candidates are benchmarked on malformed, unknown-macro, nested-environment, comment, math, citation, location, and round-trip fixtures before selection.
product_requirements.statement: All parser adapters must emit the same source-map and protected-span contract; no parser is authoritative merely because it accepts a document.
product_requirements.title: Format-aware parser contract

product_requirements.acceptance_test: Every adoption candidate has one provenance record and one explicit hold or adopt decision, and adoption is impossible unless its benchmark status is effectiveness-pass and independent review is recorded.
product_requirements.statement: Treat package availability, operational suitability, and writing effectiveness as separate decisions; only a held-out human-labelled benchmark supports adoption.
product_requirements.title: Evidence-tiered package adoption

proposal.decision_rule: Do not claim efficacy from the one-document feasibility run. Require a preregistered, power-justified paired or stepped rollout against a documented baseline, report uncertainty, and stratify by baseline writer skill and task class.
proposal.efficacy_design: paired or stepped rollout over live documents, selected before outcomes are inspected
proposal.estimand: change in human-feedback rounds to reader acceptance, subject to no increase in meaning-preservation violations or reader time
proposal.feasibility_scope: one live document for integration, telemetry, privacy, stop-rule, and burden testing only
kill_criteria: reader acceptance does not improve or becomes slower after two pilot cycles
meaning-preservation violations exceed the pre-specified tolerance
diagnostic false positives consume more review time than they save
privacy or disclosure requirements cannot be met
proposal.planning_scope: Twelve weeks covers implementation and one feasibility document; efficacy timing follows the power or precision analysis and live-document arrival rate.
proposal.resource_assumption: one product engineer, one research/evaluation lead, and part-time domain reviewer; planning assumption, not an observed cost
proposal.sample_size_rule: simulate power or precision from the observed baseline distribution of feedback rounds and reader clustering; do not choose an arbitrary document count

purpose: Produce an auditable evidence base for the humanvoice implementation proposal. The audit must distinguish discovery, screening, evidence extraction, and product decisions.

questions.text: What empirically observed failure modes occur in AI-assisted scholarly and professional writing?
Which human, model, or workflow interventions improve reader-perceived quality, factuality, comprehension, or revision efficiency?
Which evaluation methods and metrics have evidence of validity against human judgments?
What effects on agency, ownership, diversity, convergence, and professional practice must the product account for?
What software components are available, maintained, extensible, privacy-compatible, and measurable for the implementation?
What evidence is strong enough to justify each humanvoice product requirement and what remains uncertain?

review_type: systematic mapping review plus structured software landscape audit

screening.sampling_note: Dual-review every known-item candidate and a deterministic, stratified first-pass sample of relevant records; unresolved or included records then require full-text review.

github_queries: LaTeX document object model macro expansion

software_audit.selection_rule: Metadata establishes availability; only a reproducible adapter on a locked, human-labelled corpus can establish effectiveness.

title: Humanvoice literature and software audit protocol
